<!-- Cookie Head -->
<link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css"
  href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/cookieconsent@3/build/cookieconsent.min.css" />
<style id="cookie-consent-styles">
  @media only screen and (max-width: 600px) {
    .cc-window {
      display: flex !important;
      flex-direction: row !important;
      padding: 10px !important;
      color: #201845 !important;
      box-shadow: 4px -1px 13px -7px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75) !important;
      background-color: rgb(216 234 246) !important;
    }

    .cc-theme-classic .cc-btn {
      min-width: auto !important;
      text-wrap: nowrap;
      margin-left: 5px;
      background-color: #3996d2 !important;
    }

    .cc-message.cc-message {
      margin-bottom: 0px !important;
      font-size: 14px !important;
      line-height: 16px !important;
    }

    .cc-message .cc-link {
      padding: 0 !important;
      color: #201845 !important;
    }
  }
</style>

<style>
  .hide {
    display: none
  }

  .iti--allow-dropdown {
    grid-column-end: span 2;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    width: 100%;
  }

/*   body {
    background-color: transparent !important
  } */

  .cc-bottom {
    bottom: 0 !important;
  }

  .cc-window.cc-floating {
    max-width: none !important;
  }

  @media only screen and (max-width: 600px) {

    /* Initially make the banner visible */
    .cc-window.cc-visible {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
      transition: opacity 0.5s ease, transform 0.5s ease;
    }

    /* When hidden, slide it down */
    .cc-window.cc-hidden {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(100%);
      transition: opacity 0.5s ease, transform 0.5s ease;
    }

    .footer-popout-cta {
      display: none;
    }
  }
</style>
